distinguishing_from: SYNTHETIC. Status only; body is 0 bytes and there is NO Retry-After header, which is exactly what a real rate-limit response would carry.
notes: Documents the shape but not the evidence. A production 429 fixture should be kept for the Retry-After, X-RateLimit-Remaining and X-RateLimit-Reset headers, which are the actual discriminators.

DELIBERATELY NOT COLLECTED. Inducing a real 429 means hammering a third-party server, which the collection rules forbid. Harvest these from your own production traffic instead, where they occur naturally, and keep the full header block.
